name: Empty Box: Kong Hezi
source:
I have been watching you all along... I haven't missed a single move you've made. So, you should only look at me, too, okay? My gaze can never be moved away from you. If you only gaze at me, too... we will never be separated again.

— The moment you clicked on him, you had already stepped into the cage he carefully built for you.—

Empty Box: 空盒子 is a female-oriented romance visual novel woven with meta elements, psychological horror, and unsettling twists.

This is not just a love story.

It is a game about memory, choice, and obsession.

[From [url=https://mimu2026.itch.io/empty-box]Itch[/url]]
